messages:
maria: Need a clear rollout plan for routing-adaptive_v2. Target: Hosted + Dedicated. Goal: per-tenant fallback policies + region-aware canaries with no customer disruption.
kevin: Agreed. Proposal: region-first canaries. Start internal -> us-west -> eu-central -> ap-southeast -> global. Each region: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 6-12h hold at each step.
anita: Feature flag: ff.routing.adaptive_v2. Variants: control, v2. Support targeting by region and tenant. Global kill: ff.routing.adaptive_v2.disable_all = true.
taro: Suggest prioritizing top 8 EA customers for deterministic fallback behavior. Offer them per-tenant override to opt-in to v2 early.
maria: Launch success metrics (proposal):
- error_rate delta <= +3%
- latency P95 delta <= +25ms
- fallback_rate <= 5% (unless expected for specific tenant)
- resource delta (GPU/CPU) <= +12%
kevin: SRE abort rules (must be enforced automatically):
- if error_rate > 2x baseline for 10m -> immediate rollback
- if request queue depth increases > 25% for 15m -> pause region
- if P99 latency > 2x baseline -> pause and investigate
anita: Instrumentation checklist:
- metrics: route_success, fallback_count, fallback_reason (tag), route_latency_ms
- histogram for latency by region and tenant_id
- sampling for fallback logs to 5% to limit volume
maria: A/B holdback: reserve 10% worldwide traffic as holdback control for quality/cost comparison. Run eval prompt set weekly against both variants.
taro: CS asks: lightweight EA dashboard widget showing fallbacks by tenant + last 24h trend. Can we ship a simple Grafana panel and a tiny customer-facing view?
kevin: Yes. Create Grafana panel: "Routing: fallbacks by tenant" and add alert: fallback_rate > 5% for 1h OR >8% for 15m. Hook to #eng-oncall.
anita: Rollout CLI playbook example:
```
# enable 5% in eu-central
redwood ff set ff.routing.adaptive_v2 --variant v2 --percent 5 --scope eu-central
# pause rollout
redwood ff set ff.routing.adaptive_v2 --pause
# kill all
redwood ff set ff.routing.adaptive_v2.disable_all --value true
```
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-adaptive_v2 canary 2025-09-10T03:00Z -> 2025-09-12T03:00Z
maria: Important: on-prem / air-gapped will be excluded from initial rollout. We'll provide a config bundle + docs after 2 weeks post-global. Security review required for Dedicated before GA.
taro: Customer request: make fallback_reason explicit in traces (capacity, model_mismatch, timeout, policy_denied). Ops to cap trace sampling.
kevin: We'll add fallback_reason tag and cap at 1% full traces, 5% structured events. Also add aggregated counts to metrics.
anita: Testing plan:
- unit + e2e with simulated region failures
- chaos test: introduce 30% dropped capacity in one region and validate fallback path
- rollback test: simulate abort rule and verify system reverts in <2m
maria: Rollout cadence per region:
- internal tenants 0 -> 100% in 24h if stable
- public region canary 0->5% (12h) -> 20% (12h) -> 50% (24h) -> 100% (24h)
- holdbacks: global 10% for A/B for first 14 days
kevin: Ops alerts and dashboards ready checklist:
- tenant-filterable Grafana panels 
- SLO dashboards with baseline comparisons
- oncall runbook with abort and rollback steps
anita: Ownership: I own FF rollout implementation and playbook. Kevin owns alerts/oncall automation. Taro owns EA customer coordination + dashboard requests. Maria will own launch gating and final sign-off.
maria: Final pre-canary checklist:
- [ ] FF targeting + kill switch implemented
- [ ] Metrics + Grafana panels live
- [ ] EA customers onboarded + opt-in list finalized
- [ ] Rollout playbook + abort criteria documented in Confluence
- [ ] Security sign-off for Dedicated
kevin: I'll add an automated job to monitor the abort rules and notify #eng-oncall and paging if triggered.
taro: I'll produce a short docs blurb for CS explaining the new fallback reasons and how to read the EA dashboard.
maria: Good. I'll post this summary to #eng-oncall and schedule a short pre-launch sync at 02:30Z one hour before the canary window. Ping if blockers. :rocket:
